title: Television - 1125/60 High-Definition Production System - Digital Representation and Bit-Parallel Interface
scope: This standard specifies the digital representation of the signal parameters of the 1125/60 high-definition production system as given in their analog form by ANSI/SMPTE 240M. This standard also specifies the signal format and the mechanical and electrical characteristics of the bitparallel digital interface for the interconnection of digital television equipment operating in the 1125/60 high-definition production system.
